div.span: [Local LLM server and manager: Tauri app, windowless server, Rust core]
div.div: Downloads and runs engines and models, queues requests, loads a model when it fits and releases it when idle, keeps per-app keys, limits and usage history, model presets and engine pins, and answers on 127.0.0.1:11435. The app and tray manage it; closing the app never stops serving.

text.tspan: [Local LLM server and manager: Tauri app,
Downloads and runs engines and models,
queues requests, loads a model when it fits
and releases it when idle, keeps per-app
keys, limits and usage history, model presets
and engine pins, and answers on
127.0.0.1:11435. The app and tray manage it;
closing the app never stops serving.
